 KALISPELL, Mont. — A multi-vehicle crash on the Highway 93 Bypass near Three-Mile Drive left a 17-year-old girl critically injured Thursday morning, and investigators are still working to determine what happened.
 The Kalispell Police Department, Flathead County Sheriff’s Office and Kalispell Fire Department were dispatched to the crash at 10 a.m. 
 Multiple vehicles were involved. The victim was critically injured and taken to Logan Health, where she remains in critical condition.
 The Kalispell Police Department is investigating the circumstances surrounding the crash.
